trailhead.name: Slate Creek (Chancellor) Road #54-700 locked gate, about 3,800 ft (drive Harts Pass, down Slate Creek road)

identifiedBy.fact: parked at locked gate 3,800 ft; 1.5 mi on South Fork Slate Creek road to bridge at 4,000 ft, then east ridge; also lemkeclimbs.com and countryhighpoints.com, plus the route's own text

otherFacts.value: 4000 (South Fork Slate Creek, bridge rebuilt over old one)
about 5000 round trip, about 9 mi (2010 two-day party)
about 8.5 h round trip from the gate in 2018
45-degree snowfield near 7300 ft; class 4 green slot or class 4 corner; low 5th step at summit block

notes: Opened and used the gate: lemkeclimbs (2019), countryhighpoints (2018), trailcatjim (2010), route text. All three agree; none names another start. Gate is unnamed with no printed coordinate; no USFS/NPS match (Harts Pass points are 7+ km away and are NOT the start, and in 2019 the road beyond Harts Pass was walked in snow). WTA Mount Ballard page prints 48.7064,-120.9177 which is the Hwy 20 Canyon Creek side (west face), NOT this gate: do not use. Blocked: cascadeclimbers 403; stevensong page unreadable (nav only). Placements empty by rule.

trailhead.name: Paradise (Henry M. Jackson Visitor Center area), Mount Rainier NP

identifiedBy.fact: started at Paradise, Kautz Cleaver to the couloir; also turns-all-year May 3-4 2013 and success-couloir reports from Paradise

notes: WEAK-ish found, ski-descent reports dominate. Opened: turns-all-year May 30 (Paradise), May 3-4 2013 (Paradise, camp on Wapowety Cleaver, traverse to Success Glacier ~8,000 ft), success-couloir (Paradise 1:30 AM, exit via Comet Falls TH), mt-rainier-success-glacier-couloir 2020 (Comet Falls/Van Trump start), may-13-15-2014 (no trailhead named). So Paradise 3, Comet Falls/Van Trump 1, Westside Road 0. MP page and route text list all three without ranking, say Paradise or Van Trump easiest. No page calls another start the usual. One fetch summary of the May 3-4 page added an odd line saying no start should be treated as usual; not verifiable, ignored. No official coordinate printed for the Paradise lot (NPS page has none; officialCandidates have no Paradise-named point, only Skyline/Alta Vista/Nisqually Vista trailheads at Paradise). Placements empty. cascadeclimbers 403, skisickness 404.

No page about this route. Mountain Project North Peak area (106324862, Gunsight Range, coords 48.5093,-120.66) lists only a West Face 5.11+ and no approach; that coordinate differs from the row's 48.3068,-120.994, so peak identity is doubtful. wildsnow Gunsight article (does not mention North Peak) approaches from Stehekin via ferry, bus and PCT/Agnes Creek bushwhack. Sibling West Face uses Downey Creek: not evidence. 2 searches, no route page found. Starts possible: Downey Creek, Stehekin/PCT, none supported.

otherFacts.value: Cloudy Peak to North Star ridge steep and corniced early season; SE face of North Star gentle after dropping to about 6600 ft

notes: Starts in use: (1) Trinity TH via Buck Creek Pass and Suiattle Pass to Cloudy Pass: countryhighpoints (opened; he tried the Cloudy Peak ridge, retreated, took SE face) and lemkeclimbs Cloudy Peak trip (opened, Trinity to Holden). (2) Phelps Creek TH over Spider Gap: summitpost gimpilator log 2015, seen only as search summary, page 403. (3) Holden Village/Lucerne ferry and Railroad Creek: WTA North Star page (opened, lists Lyman Lakes trailhead 48.1984,-120.7746, says Holden closed through summer 2026). Even split, none about this exact traverse standard. Blocked: summitpost 403, cascadeclimbers 403.

otherFacts.value: Middle Fork Nooksack FS road from Mosquito Lake Rd; gate may be closed, bikes left near fire pit past Dailey Prairie (South/North Twin west ridge)

notes: Only start named: Dailey Prairie (Mountain Project Skookum area, opened; hike over west ridge of South Twin). That is a place on the Middle Fork Nooksack road system, not a signed trailhead; MP West Ridge page describes driving/biking the Middle Fork Nooksack road past Dailey Prairie to a single-track and bike stash. Nearest official point Middle Fork Nooksack Trailhead 48.726672,-121.900293 (USFS, 6.8 km) is a different, unconfirmed lead; Elbow Lake Trailhead is the sibling scramble's start and unsupported here. Cascadeclimbers 2012 Skookum north ridge TR (via search summary only, 403) also reached Dailey Prairie then South Twin west ridge. Mountaineers pages 403. No signed lot tied to Dailey Prairie, so stuck.
